name: example_neuro_pack
description: Example versioned domain pack (WO-0.3.6). Quality bar: operationalization + one primary unknown.

questions.question: Which synaptic plasticity rules best explain credit assignment across multi-area cortical loops?
questions.operationalization: Compare candidate plasticity rules in a multi-area network model against measured credit-assignment signatures in at least two cortical datasets.
questions.why_it_matters: Credit assignment across areas constrains theories of learning and neuromodulation.
assumptions: Partial observability of inter-area synapses is acceptable.

questions.question: Which purported replications of multi-area credit-assignment signatures fail under Z measurement protocols, and why?
questions.operationalization: Catalog claimed signatures with failed replication under alternate measurement Z; report fraction failing and missing negative controls across ≥5 studies.
questions.why_it_matters: Credit-assignment claims may look settled under one assay while failing under another.
assumptions: Replication attempts can be coded from literature without inventing unpublished labs.
